<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

/**
 * @property int $id
 * @property string $title
 * @property Carbon|null $created_at
 * @property Carbon|null $updated_at
 * @property string $excerpt
 */
class Report extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;

    protected $fillable = ['title', 'excerpt'];
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Requests;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

class StoreReportRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'excerpt' => 'required|string',
            'title' => 'required|string|max:255',
        ];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Requests;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

class UpdateReportRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'excerpt' => 'sometimes|required|string',
            'title' => 'sometimes|required|string|max:255',
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Models\Report;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;

/**
 * @extends Factory<Report>
 */
class ReportFactory extends Factory
{
    protected $model = Report::class;

    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'excerpt' => fake()->sentence(),
            'title' => fake()->word(),
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Resources;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\JsonResource;

class ReportResource extends JsonResource
{
    /**
     * Transform the resource into an array.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(Request $request): array
    {
        return [
            'excerpt' => $this->excerpt,
            'id' => $this->id,
            'title' => $this->title,
            'created_at' => $this->created_at,
            'updated_at' => $this->updated_at,
        ];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\DTO;

use App\Http\Requests\StoreReportRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateReportRequest;

readonly class ReportDTO
{
    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>|null  $provided
     */
    public function __construct(
        public ?string $title = null,
        public ?string $excerpt = null,
        private ?array $provided = null
    ) {}

    public static function fromRequest(StoreReportRequest|UpdateReportRequest $request): self
    {
        return self::fromArray($request->validated());
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data  validated input, whatever sent it
     */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            title: isset($data['title']) ? (string) $data['title'] : null,
            excerpt: isset($data['excerpt']) ? (string) $data['excerpt'] : null,
            provided: array_keys($data)
        );
    }

    /**
     * The fields the request sent, or every property when built by hand.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        $values = get_object_vars($this);
        unset($values['provided']);

        return $this->provided === null ? $values : array_intersect_key($values, array_flip($this->provided));
    }
}
